2.3.3 Expectation, variance and standard deviation of a continuous random variable

If X is a continuous random variable, then expected value of X is given by E(X)=\int_x x\,f(x)\,dx, provided that it exists.

Example 2.16

Let X be a continuous random variable with pdf given by

$f(x)=\left\{\begin{matrix}\frac{x}{2} & 0\le x\le 2\\ 0 & \textit{otherwise}\end{matrix}\right.$

Find the mean, variance and standard deviation of X.

Solution:

(i) By definition

\text{Mean}=E(X)=\int_x x\,f(x)\,dx

=\int_{0}^{2}x\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)dx=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}x^2dx=\frac{1}{2}\left.\left(\frac{x^3}{3}\right)\right|_{0}^{2}

=\left.\left(\frac{x^3}{6}\right)\right|_{0}^{2}=\frac{8}{6}-0=\frac{4}{3}=1.333

(ii) By definition

V(X)=E(X^2)-[E(X)]^2

=\int_{0}^{2}x^2f(x)\,dx-\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^2

=\int_{0}^{2}x^2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)dx-\frac{16}{9}

=\int_{0}^{2}\frac{x^3}{2}dx-\frac{16}{9}=\left.\frac{x^4}{8}\right|_{0}^{2}-\frac{16}{9}=\left(\frac{16}{8}-0\right)-\frac{16}{9}

=2-1.78=0.22

(iii)\quad S.D(X)=\sqrt{0.22}=0.47

$f(x)=\left\{\begin{matrix}(2-2x), & 0\le x\le 1\\ 0 & \textit{otherwise}\end{matrix}\right.$

Find (i) E(X) (ii) E(X²) (iii) E(2X) (iv) E(2X−1) (v) variance and standard deviation of X
